headlineLines: The second brand, on the shared machinery.
sections.subheading: Same blocks, same chrome, O3’s composition — painted in O3XO’s tokens. This page is scaffolding: it exists so the paint can be judged before there is content to judge it against.

children.text: This band stores the surface role “bone”. O3 paints it a warm off-white; O3XO paints it a cool grey. Neither app renames the value, and no component knows which brand it is rendering under — the whole difference is one attribute on the html element.

sections.heading: The content comes next.
sections.body: O3XO’s insights and case studies migrate into this model through the same pipeline WordPress goes through. Until they do, the routes resolve and the collections are empty.

migration.provisionalNote: Scaffolding, not content (#215). It exists so apps/o3xo has a homepage to render while the paint is evaluated, and its copy describes the mechanism rather than the brand — no Figma frame, no o3xo.ai source. Cleared by O3XO's own homepage, composed once the adaptation delta is reviewed and the migrated content (#217, #218) is in the dataset.
